name: random-walk
description: A web application to discover and track random walks to interesting local places

scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.version:sync: npm run version:sync:frontend && npm run version:sync:backend
scripts.release: npm run version:sync && npm run docker:build && git add . && git commit -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git tag "v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
